ios.desc:
Diary – Hope Tree

A quiet place to write, reflect, and grow — with a gentle cat by your side.

Diary – Hope Tree is a simple, private growth diary for everyday life.
There’s no pressure to be productive, positive, or consistent.
Just a calm space to show up as you are.

Write a few words about your day.
Note a small step toward something you care about — even if it’s for tomorrow.
Reflect honestly, even when things feel hard.

Nothing more is required.

A gentle way to grow

Diary — write what happened today, even the ordinary things

Hope — keep a simple goal you’re growing toward

Reflection — a few honest words are enough

Action — note a small step, past or future

Tool - to support the hope

No streaks.
No scores.
No pressure to “do better”.

A quiet companion

Your cat doesn’t guide, judge, or demand anything.
It simply stays with you — day by day — as you write and grow at your own pace.

Private by design

Private — your entries are yours

No ads

Nothing is shared

This is your personal space. Always.

 For people who...

Want to keep a diary without feeling guilty

Prefer honesty over positivity

Need a calm place during busy or difficult times

Care about privacy and simplicity


If you want a quiet place to exist, reflect, and grow —
 Hope Tree is here.

It is a space for reflection, intention-setting, and gentle daily practices.


Private by design

Your entries are yours

No ads

No subscription required

Nothing is shared

Your diary stays personal, simple, and calm.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Hope Tree – a calm, minimal reflection app

quotes.text:
I made Hope Tree, which helps people reflect and build small moments of hope during difficult times.

It’s a mix of a simple journaling tool and a calm, lightweight emotional companion, designed to be private and distraction-free.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/hope-tree/id6753673053
